reason: I'm not putting an unaudited proxy with no customers in front of order flow at a crypto venue, and the identity check rests on a passport registry the same founder started. We already rate-limit every key, so for now I'd tinker with the free tier at most and wouldn't pay anything.
objection: AINRA is the vendor's own registry. If the gatekeeper and the passport issuer are the same people, the identity check isn't independent, and without SOC 2 I can't get it past my own security review anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Support for an open, independently governed Know-Your-Agent standard (not just AINRA), plus a finished SOC 2 and one live venue I can call as a reference.
